Grant carried Arkansas, but Congress rejected all 6 of its electoral votes for irregularities Horace Greeley was the Liberal Republican nominee and was also endorsed by the Democratic Party; he is listed under the Democratic column, where the county file records his votes. Arkansas's 1872 return was disputed, and Congress counted none of Arkansas's electoral votes. The World Almanac 1873, p. 75, prints the return of Arkansas's Secretary of State: Greeley 37,927, Grant 41,073. It is not published here, as with Louisiana; the record keeps the county-file sums.
